title: Amplify-compatible engine (for Apricitus storage)
description:
Make Virtuus the embeddable engine behind Apricitus's local backends (design: `~/Projects/Ripple/design/storage.md` §3.1; Apricitus initiative `apricitus-e70662`): pluggable storage, errors as values, key-based pagination, multi-process safety with a change log, and three new crates: `virtuus-blobs` (files), `virtuus-amplify` (operations shaped like Amplify Gen2's `client.models.X`) and `virtuus-appsync` (a GraphQL server answering AppSync's schema).

## Definition of done
- `make check` green: lint, specs in both languages, 100% coverage, parity.
- New crates live in the Cargo workspace under `rust/crates/`, each with `@rust-only` specs at 100% coverage.
- 0.6.0 prepared on `develop` (CHANGELOG, versions, docs). Not published or tagged without the user.

Branch: `feature/amplify-engine` off `develop`.
